sources.excerpt: Wampler Pedals Tweed ’57 Limited Edition | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Overdrive / Wampler Pedals Tweed ’57 Limited Edition Tweed ’57 Limited Edition The Wampler Tweed '57 is a limited-edition overdrive pedal designed to emulate the warm, woolly tones of classic tweed-style amplifiers, celebrated by blues, country, and rock musicians. This pedal delivers a wide range of sounds reminiscent of iconic guitar tones from artists like Keith Richards and Eric Clapton. Available exclusively from Wamplerpedals.com, it offers versatile tonal shaping and features expected from Wampler, a must-have for players seeking authentic vintage amp sounds. What Wampler Pedals say about the Tweed ’57 Limited Edition Coveted by blues, country, and rock players alike – tweed-style amplifiers have been staples in famous musicians’ live and studio setups since their introduction. With their warm and woolly sound and pushed volume tube break-up, the tone of tweed amps have found their way on to numerous historic recordings of some legendary artists such as Keith Richards, Eric Clapton, Neil Young, Billy Gibbons, and Joe Bonamassa. Those historic tweed-style amps and their legendary tones are responsible for the inspiration behind the Wampler Tweed ‘57. This pedal offers a wide tonal palette of sounds and includes several features that you’ve come to expect from Wampler. This is a limited edition pedal and only available to purchase online from Wamplerpedals.com. Once they’re gone, they’re gone! www.wamplerpedals.com What guitarists say... Guitarists were impressed with the Wampler Tweed '57's sound quality and versatility, appreciating the ease of achieving the desired 'chewy, gooey, woolly' tones. Users found the provided settings helpful, and the bright and link switch added to the pedal's flexibility. Some reviewers mentioned looking for the [Black Face 65], a limited edition pedal by Wampler. Read reviews on www.wamplerpedals.com Tweed ’57 Limited Edition compared to ...
